question: What is the cash position and runway?

beat.line: Six months earlier it was three point one one million — the burn shows a company mid-transition.
beat.headline: $3.11M → $1.85M
beat.action: The stack shrinks coin by coin; a torn-paper arrow slides in and points down.

sources: As of 30th September 2025, Diginex held $1.85M in cash and cash equivalents — a significant decline from $3.11M six months earlier.
The burn reflects the company's transition phase: heavy integration spending on the Resulticks acquisition and operational losses as the platform consolidates.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: soft violet. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: the coin stack; a torn-paper arrow.
Opens on the coin stack, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The stack shrinks coin by coin; a torn-paper arrow slides in and points down.
Ends holding on the arrow.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "$3.11M → $1.85M".

COPY LIST: "$3.11M → $1.85M". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Six months earlier it was three point one one million — the burn shows a company mid-transition.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Modern editorial 2D paper collage style, Static Shot. The frame opens anchored on <Picture 1> against a flat matte soft violet paper background. In the center sits a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of stacked metallic coins with rough white torn-paper edges, resting atop a torn cream paper strip with crisp upper-left lighting. Immediately, a warm, brisk narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Six months earlier it was three point one one million — the burn shows a company mid-transition.</d> Simultaneously, the coin stack rapidly reduces layer by layer in a snappy cut-paper animation. A matte black torn-paper arrow slides rapidly into frame from the upper right, snapping to a stop pointing downward toward the shrinking stack. A new cream paper chip sharply slaps into position, clearly displaying the bold sans-serif text "$3.11M → $1.85M". The composition settles with a subtle paper overshoot and holds completely stable through the end of the 5-second duration.

overall_soundscape: Tactile, dry paper-rustling sound effects accompany the shrinking coins, paired with a sharp paper-slap and subtle tape snap as the arrow and new text chip hit the surface.
